plan.title: bug(scm,platform): CURSOR_AGENT treated as proof of cloud on local desktop, silently skipping every SCM gate

narratives.Description: bug(scm,platform): CURSOR_AGENT treated as proof of cloud on local desktop, silently skipping every SCM gate
narratives.Overview:
Split from #3656 by the #3693 arc. This issue owns the LOCAL half only; #3656 retains the cloud half.

`intake/platform-capabilities.ts` and `platform/platform-capabilities.ts` both treat `CURSOR_AGENT` as proof of a cloud runtime. It is not -- local desktop Cursor sets it too. Local desktop sessions therefore classify `cloud-headless`, infer `injected-token`, find no `GH_TOKEN`, and return not-ready while a healthy keyring `gh` login sits unused. `SCM_DEPENDENT_GATES` are then skipped, and the skip is advisory, so the agent is never told its work-selection surface is gone.

RECUT 2026-08-28 after audit 5455280918 returned STEER. Two rejected routes:
- Removing the `CURSOR_AGENT` hop grants `host-gh` on a real cloud VM by marker ABSENCE.
- `process.platform === "win32"` (the originally bound direction, now WITHDRAWN) is not a sound discriminator. Cursor runs Windows "My Machines" workers where the agent loop is in Cursor's cloud while commands execute on a Windows machine, so `CURSOR_AGENT` + Windows does not entail local desktop. And "managed VMs are Ubuntu" is a versioned fact about a third party's fleet, not a runtime invariant; the day it changes, a win32 carve-out silently grants `host-gh` on a managed VM.

Bound direction (operator decision, explicit-selection route): Cursor-managed VMs serve a metadata API on `CURSOR_AGENT_SOCKET` whose `agent/runtime` is always `managed`, and self-hosted workers do not serve it. A successful read is a POSITIVE assertion of managed cloud, so it becomes the highest-precedence cloud deny. Socket absence means "not managed, or unreachable" and must NEVER select `host-gh`; it leaves the runtime ambiguous. An ambiguous runtime requires an explicit operator or dispatcher `host-gh` selection before host credentials are used.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Verify hop ordering in BOTH classifiers against HEAD rather than trusting prose. `intake/platform-capabilities.ts` runs its CI loop (GROK_BUILD, GITHUB_ACTIONS, CI, BUILDKITE, DEFT_AGENT_RUNTIME) before the Cursor hop; `platform/platform-capabilities.ts` checked CURSOR_AGENT FIRST, above its CI hops.
2. Add `platform/cursor-managed-runtime.ts`: an injectable managed-runtime probe reading `agent/runtime` over `CURSOR_AGENT_SOCKET`, stable reason ids, and the explicit-selection predicate. The probe short-circuits when the socket env is unset, so the local path pays nothing. Both error directions are safe: a false `managed` denies host credentials, and a failed read leaves the runtime ambiguous.
3. Give both classifiers one shared precedence order: CI markers, then a positive managed read, then Cursor sandbox, then the ambiguous Cursor hop. This moves the platform classifier's Cursor hop BELOW its CI hops so neither a CI marker nor a managed read can be overridden by the explicit selection.
4. Explicit-selection surface: env var `DEFT_GITHUB_AUTH_MODE=host-gh`. Chosen over a policy field because the ambiguity is a property of the execution environment, not of the repository -- a committed policy flag would propagate to other machines and to managed VMs. Named for the `github_auth_mode` dispatch-envelope field so a dispatcher exports the label it already records.
5. Make the skip visible: `runtime_mode_reason` in `scmReadinessToDict`, the reason on the skipped-gates line, and the opt-in named in the remediation the operator meets when blocked.
6. Regressions for the precedence contract, plus CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]`.
narratives.LockedDecisions:
- `process.platform` is NOT an input to either classifier. The win32 direction is withdrawn (audit 5455280918).
- A positive managed-runtime read outranks the explicit selection. An operator opt-in can never authorize host credentials on a managed VM.
- Probe absence or failure is ambiguous, never local.
- Absent an explicit selection, behaviour is unchanged from before this change.
- Diagnostics (reason string, regressions) are observability, not the safety case; the safety case is the precedence contract.
narratives.Decisions:
- xbrief/decisions/2026-08-28-resolve-an-ambiguous-cursor-runtime-with-an-explicit-deft-github.decision.json — Resolve an ambiguous Cursor runtime with an explicit DEFT_GITHUB_AUTH_MODE=host-gh env selection, and deny managed cloud by a positive CURSOR_AGENT_SOCKET agent/runtime read
- xbrief/decisions/2026-08-28-memoize-only-a-positive-managed-runtime-read-re-probe-every-inco.decision.json — Memoize only a positive managed-runtime read; re-probe every inconclusive verdict

items.title: Positive managed-runtime read classifies cloud-headless at highest Cursor precedence

narrative.Acceptance: Given a Cursor-managed VM whose metadata API reports agent/runtime=managed, when the runtime is classified, then it is cloud-headless, ahead of the sandbox hop, the Cursor-marker hop, and any explicit host-gh selection.

items.title: Probe absence or failure never selects host credentials

narrative.Acceptance: Given the metadata socket is unset, unreachable, or does not report managed, when the runtime is classified, then it is not local on that basis and host credentials are not selected.

x-directive/evidence.pointer: packages/core/src/platform/cursor-managed-runtime.test.ts#leaves the runtime ambiguous, not local, when the probe is unavailable

items.title: Ambiguous runtime requires explicit selection; absent it, behaviour is unchanged

narrative.Acceptance: Given CURSOR_AGENT is set and no managed read, when no explicit selection is present, then the verdict is unchanged from today; when DEFT_GITHUB_AUTH_MODE=host-gh is set, then the runtime resolves to local-unsandboxed.

items.title: With the selection and a healthy gh, scm:* succeed and no gates are skipped

narrative.Acceptance: Given local desktop with CURSOR_AGENT=1, no injected token, a healthy authenticated gh, and the explicit selection, when readiness is probed, then it is ready in host-gh mode and SCM_DEPENDENT_GATES is empty.

x-directive/evidence.pointer: packages/core/src/scm/readiness.test.ts#is ready with an explicit selection and a healthy host gh

items.title: A Windows GitHub Actions runner still classifies cloud-headless

narrative.Acceptance: Given a CI marker, when the runtime is classified, then it is cloud-headless even alongside CURSOR_AGENT and an explicit host-gh selection.

x-directive/evidence.pointer: packages/core/src/platform/cursor-managed-runtime.test.ts#keeps CI precedence over both the Cursor hop and the explicit selection

items.title: Skipped SCM gates are operator-visible with their reason and the opt-in

narrative.Acceptance: Given SCM-dependent gates are skipped, when scm:status --json or the session-start lines are read, then runtime_mode_reason is present and the ambiguous case names the DEFT_GITHUB_AUTH_MODE opt-in.

x-directive/evidence.pointer: packages/core/src/scm/readiness.test.ts#names the ambiguity and the opt-in when it blocks

items.title: No path selects host credentials from marker absence or an OS predicate alone

narrative.Acceptance: Given any environment, when the runtime is classified, then process.platform is not consulted and no absence of a marker selects host credentials.
Given the change lands, then CHANGELOG [Unreleased] carries a line.

clauses.text: A managed-runtime probe classifies a Cursor-managed VM as cloud-headless on a positive read, at higher precedence than other Cursor signals.
On an ambiguous runtime, host credentials require explicit operator or dispatcher selection; without it, behaviour is unchanged.
With that selection present on local desktop with a healthy authenticated gh, scm:* verbs succeed and SCM-dependent gates are not skipped.
A Windows GitHub Actions runner still classifies cloud-headless.
Skipped SCM gates are operator-visible, not advisory-only.
No path selects host credentials from marker absence or from an OS predicate alone.

intended_placement.cohesion_exemption: CHANGELOG.md is an append-only release ledger; the declared edit is a single [Unreleased] line required by acceptance clause 7. Splitting the ledger is not an available remedy and its length is unrelated to this change's cohesion.
